title: Voice Negotiation Agents: Pipecat, LiveKit and GPT-Live negotiating freight rates in Spanish
description:
Code and data for an externally measured comparison of three voice-agent architectures that negotiate freight rates by phone in Mexican Spanish: two cascades orchestrated by Pipecat and by LiveKit Agents, and OpenAI's GPT-Live speech model. Includes the three agents, the shared negotiation engine, prompt and tools, the measurement harness and the simulated agents that validate it, the exported per-call and per-turn tables, and the scripts that regenerate every number in the paper.

Accompanying paper: Latency, Speech Recognition and Turn-Taking in Voice Agents for Spanish Phone Negotiation: An Externally Measured Comparison of Pipecat, LiveKit and GPT-Live.
